name: Joshikousei Kairaku Tokkyuu ~Chikan Junkie~
original_name: 女子校生快楽特急～痴漢ジャンキー～
source:
Main heroine is a class chairman, but stress accumulates while dealing with the problem classmates. Masturbation in the toilet becomes her means of stress relief. One day she decides to go home without her panties on. And such trivial mischief leads to her libido bloom...
